about.introduction: I am Dr. Sishu Shankar Muni, an Assistant Professor at the School of Digital Sciences, Digital University Kerala. My research revolves around Dynamical Systems, Nonlinear Dynamics, Network of Oscillators, Data Science, High-Performance Computing, and Machine Learning.
